name: bizplug-car-rental
description: The car rental plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: vehicle availability and rental price. It works from the business's own published profile, covering vehicle classes, requirements, fees and reservation requests, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
